name: Tsukimi
source:
A girl who fell in love with a [url=https://vndb.org/c139567]bedridden boy[/url] at the hospital, and becomes a sinner in her attempts to save him. Whether she was successful or not in saving him is a mystery... 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/05/28/karuta/]official site[/url]]
